project_info.color_palette: Bright yellow, royal blue, white, black

main_subject.detail: A bold square sale poster built around oversized Vietnamese typography announcing a buy-2-get-4 offer. The layout uses a vivid yellow background, thick blue-and-white outlined headline blocks, two glossy blue information badges, a gift-ribbon line graphic, and cropped underwear product visuals at the frame edge.
main_subject.style: High-impact ecommerce promotion, flat graphic retail poster, bold typography-led campaign, bright and energetic sale visual

composition_elements.text: BADASS, MUA 2 ĐƯỢC 4, MUA 4 ĐƯỢC 8, NHÂN ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG
items: Top Center: black BADASS wordmark on solid bright yellow background.
Center: huge stacked blue headline with thick white outline reading 'MUA 2 ĐƯỢC 4', with the number 2 integrated in the top line and the number 4 oversized on the right.
Behind Headline Right: a thin blue gift-box outline with a ribbon bow graphic emerging behind the headline.
Lower Left: a glossy rounded blue badge with white uppercase text 'MUA 4 ĐƯỢC 8'.
Lower Center-Right: another glossy rounded blue badge with white uppercase text 'NHÂN ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG'.
Lower Right Edge: cropped dark underwear product visual partially entering the frame from the right side.
Bottom Left Corner: a large cropped blue angular graphic shape for visual balance.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean high-contrast promo look, subtle glow around blue badges, cheerful energetic sale atmosphere, crisp graphic edges

technical_specs.render_style: Graphic retail promotion poster with photoreal product crop accents

prompt_instructions: If using gpt-image-2, attach the original image to preserve the exact sale typography hierarchy and spacing.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown in the source image.
Do not turn this into a lifestyle poster; it must remain a bold text-led promotional graphic.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square retail sale poster for a BADASS buy-2-get-4 promotion. Use a bright yellow background with a black BADASS wordmark centered at the top. In the middle, create a huge stacked blue headline with thick white outline reading 'MUA 2 ĐƯỢC 4', with the number 4 oversized on the right side. Behind the headline, add a thin blue gift-box outline with a ribbon bow graphic. At the lower left place a glossy rounded blue badge with white text 'MUA 4 ĐƯỢC 8'. At the lower center-right place a matching glossy rounded blue badge with white text 'NHÂN ĐÔI QUÀ TẶNG'. Add a cropped dark underwear product visual entering from the right edge and a large cropped blue angular graphic shape in the bottom-left corner. Technical style: graphic retail promotion poster with photoreal product crop accents, bright flat commercial lighting, crisp graphic edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
